title: The First Spatially Resolved Detection of <SUP>13</SUP>CN in a Protoplanetary Disk and Evidence for Complex Carbon Isotope Fractionation
question: Detect 13CN in the TW Hya disk and measure the spatially resolved 12CN/13CN ratio to constrain carbon isotope fractionation in disks

data.angular_resolution: All cubes convolved to a circular 0.5 arcsec FWHM beam, the smallest common resolution
data.sensitivity: 13CN cube RMS 1.0 mJy (per channel, after beam matching)

what.value: Dust optical depth at each wavelength used in the three-layer model

evidence.quote: are the dust optical depth at each wavelength taken from (cite: maci21)

what.value: Fiducial TW Hya disk model (gas surface density and scale height at r=60 au) used to convert n(H2) to altitude z/r

evidence.quote: in the fiducial TW Hya disk model of (cite: cala21)

what.value: Disk geometry and stellar mass used for the Keplerian mask and stacking (i=5.8 deg, PA=151.6 deg, M*=0.81 Msun, vsys=2.84 km/s)
LTE relative optical depth spectrum at T=40 K for the matched filter figure

evidence.quote: a predicted relative optical depth spectrum at $T=40$ K suggested by (cite: teag20)

recipe.goal: calibrate, self-calibrate and image archival cubes
recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, phase+amplitude self-calibration on continuum, application to line SPWs, uvcontsub, tclean with Keplerian mask, imsmooth to 0.5 arcsec circular beam, impbcor
key_parameters: 13CN cube channel spacing 0.34 km/s (half the velocity resolution), robust 0.5
12CN N=2-1 cube channel width 0.1 km/s, robust 1.0
assumptions: Keplerian mask geometry: i=5.8 deg, PA=151.6 deg, M*=0.81 Msun, vsys=2.84 km/s

recipe.goal: check absolute flux consistency across datasets
recipe.method: Continuum peak intensities at 0.5 arcsec resolution fitted with a power-law SED; deviations of the three datasets compared

recipe.goal: detect 13CN via moment maps and matched filter
recipe.method: Stacked moment-zero maps of the three brightest hyperfine lines with the Keplerian mask; matched filter cross-correlating visibilities with a Keplerian-mask kernel
assumptions: LTE relative optical depth spectrum at T=40 K overplotted for comparison

recipe.method: Shift-and-stack of spectra assuming Keplerian rotation with gofish, using the CLEAN-mask geometry and disk centre from 2D Gaussian fit to continuum
key_parameters: Same geometry as for the CLEAN mask; disk outer radius 3.0 arcsec for the 13CN disk-integrated spectrum

recipe.method: 3D grids of Tk, column density and n(H2) giving peak optical depth and excitation temperature of each hyperfine line, via SpectralRadex
key_parameters: 100 grid points per dimension; Tk linear, N and n(H2) logarithmic
assumptions: All lines share the same Tk and n(H2); line width equals thermal width
Only collisions with para-H2 (rate coefficients available only for para-H2); ortho-H2 ignored

recipe.goal: fit synthetic spectra to stacked spectra with MCMC
recipe.method: Three-layer model (molecules behind, dust at midplane, molecules in front) giving synthetic spectra convolved with Gaussian broadening, compared with stacked spectra at each radius
key_parameters: Nine free parameters per radius: n(H2), Tk, N(12CN), N(13CN), vsys, and Delta v_j for four SPWs
Model spectrum generated with a 15 kHz interval
13CN sigma multiplied by sqrt(2) because channel width is half the velocity resolution
assumptions: Molecular and dust emitting regions are vertically distinct: dust settled at midplane, molecular emission from higher altitudes

recipe.goal: convert n(H2) to emitting-layer altitude and compare with literature
recipe.method: Compare fitted n(H2) with the fiducial TW Hya disk model of Calahan et al. at r=60 and 100 au to infer z/r
key_parameters: At r=60 au model gas surface density ~4 g/cm^2 and scale height ~5 au
assumptions: Mean molecular weight 2.37; Gaussian vertical gas distribution

evidence.quote: The $\rm ^{12}CN$/$\rm ^{13}CN$ ratio is measured to be $70^{+9}_{-6}$ at $30 < r < 80$ au from the central star

answer_key.quantity: 12CN/13CN ratio at the local minimum near r~100 au

evidence.quote: At the local minimum, $\rm ^{12}CN$/$\rm ^{13}CN$ is estimated to be $48^{+5}_{-4}$.
The ${\rm H_2}$ volume density is found to range between $(4 - 10)\times10^7 \ {\rm cm^{-3}}$
The column density of $\rm ^{12}CN$ ranges $10^{14-15}\ {\rm cm^{-2}}$ at r = $30-120$ au.

answer_key.quantity: Altitude of CN emission at r=60 au (n(H2)=4e7 cm^-3)

evidence.quote: corresponds to an altitude of $z/r\sim0.27$ in the model

answer_key.quantity: Altitude of CN emission at r=100 au (n(H2)~1e8 cm^-3)

evidence.quote: which corresponds to $z/r\sim0.22$ in the fiducial model of (cite: cala21)

answer_key.quantity: Continuum SED power-law index across the three datasets

evidence.quote: The SED can be well fitted by a power-law curve with an index of 2.13
The root mean square (RMS) noise level is estimated to be 1.0 mJy

score_reason: Data are public with project codes and the radiative-transfer and MCMC recipe is described with equations, priors, grids and chain settings, but imaging parameters, line-free channels, distance and several self-calibration details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Archival data, a described pipeline (self-cal, tclean, matched filter, RADEX grids, emcee) and numeric key results (70 +9/-6 and 48 +5/-4) make the headline ratio redoable, with some gaps to fill.
